prompt:
Production asset extraction/regeneration from the supplied approved paper-art storyboard. The reference is ONLY the tree's design/material reference. Replace the entire storyboard layout with a BRAND NEW SQUARE TRANSPARENT 2 by 2 sprite atlas of four isolated paper trees. Canvas target 1536x1536, at least 1024x1024. No labels, no hills, no lake, no ground, no bench, no falling petals/leaves, no loose objects, no borders, no grid lines, no drop-shadow oval, no UI. True alpha background.

EXACT GRID CONTRACT: four equally sized square cells. Top left Spring; top right Summer; bottom left Autumn; bottom right Winter. In EACH cell, trunk root point is at cell-relative x=50%, y=90%. Tree canopy spans approximately x=10%..90%; the tree's TOP is at approximately y=26%, root at90%, giving a squat airy tree about64% of the cell height. Keep large transparent padding above and a 10% transparent pad below. Do not cross any cell boundary. Four trees use the same trunk silhouette and same branching skeleton, position, scale and proportions. Preserve the wide airy branching character of the approved tree, not a tall narrow sapling.

Spring: warm brown thin cut-paper trunk and a restrained airy crown of pale pink five-petal paper blossoms.
Summer: identical trunk and branches with green paper leaves.
Autumn: identical trunk and branches with amber/golden/russet paper leaves, some empty branch tips.
Winter: identical bare branching silhouette with delicate thin white paper snow on a few branches, no leaves.

Match the approved tactile matte fibrous thin paper collage, shallow 2.5D almost-front view, crisp hand-cut contours and soft INTERNAL contact shading between overlapping paper pieces. No glossy volume, no plastic, no photoreal woody bark. Warm-brown flat paper branches, not cylindrical realistic sticks. Rooted-looking flared paper roots are part of each isolated cutout but there is absolutely NO drawn land. The result is a clean reusable atlas, not another concept sheet. Exact square 2x2 arrangement with transparent alpha is essential.
